column1: - This table is the quotable core of a vendor-facing contract-research work order.
- `price_status` must never contain a number. It is a placeholder such as
`需询价 / quote required`; the actual price comes from the vendor's quote.
- `turnaround_days` must never contain a number either; it is filled by the vendor.
- `module_id` is `M1` ... `M10`. Which modules appear depends on `--scope`:
`assay_first` (build the assay with a positive control first), `candidates`
(synthesize, express, purify and assay the candidates), or `full` (adds
catalytic-residue mutants, controls, extended characterization and optional
- `acceptance_criteria` is our acceptance criterion, not a property of the
protein. It is what we will judge the deliverable against.
- Nothing in this table is a functional conclusion. It is a purchasing document.
